title: Taming Slivers: A Robust TFEM Framework for Reliable Computations on Degenerate Tetrahedral Meshes
summary: Sliver elements are an intrinsic difficulty of three-dimensional tetrahedral mesh generation and remain costly, and sometimes impractical, to eliminate completely. Although isolated degenerate elements do not necessarily prevent finite element convergence, connected clusters or sheets of slivers may impose artificial constraints on the discrete solution, leading to locking and severe loss of accuracy. In this work, we revisit the effect of slivers from the viewpoint of the finite element solution and propose a robust solver-side treatment based on the Tempered Finite Element Method (TFEM).…
